craft_notes: Sthāyin: drop-sprinkling. Rows: deck then drops. Read aloud: aspersion.

lines: From the bowl so decked, with bloom and incense blest,
its drops sprinkle forth the rite's pith with the bloom of power.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam arghapātre nyasya puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tadvipruḍbhir yāgasāraṃ puṣpādi ca prokṣayet
